wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the contract accepts a normal node error together with no delivery and no file/URL access, so a crash on hostile input is an accepted refusal; the positive controls are the functional tests
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: outgoing mail is the only direction at this sink and there are no roles or permissions in it; the several implementations and both message formats are covered instead
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the sink only constructs outgoing messages; there is no read/write verb pair to guard differently
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: no normalising or adjusting step runs on the value before the sink decides; the coercion applies at the value read
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity or address parsing decides the protection; values are handled by their runtime type
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the protection does not consult an authority or secret that could return nothing

status: built and upgraded 2026-10-20 for BETTER-PATTERNS §2-§8. instruction.md now states one general property over outgoing email and no longer names any capability, operation, message part or injected option; the repository and the image are unchanged (no rebuild). Gmail v1 reply, a call site that never had protection and was not covered before, now has a behavioural security test. Levers: T1 landing (where), T2 far site (where), T3 uncovered Gmail route (how, M4), T4 non-text shape differential (how, M8), T5/T6 injected siblings (where extras). Earlier gate evidence: nop PASS (security 0/16); oracle PASS (3/3 runs reward 1.0, identical results); every declared check passed in at least one gate run (sf-landing-only 0.375, sf-no-legacy 0.75, sf-no-gmail 0.875, sf-objects-only 0.8125, sf-no-attachment-paths 0.875, sf-no-send-and-wait 0.875, sf-no-file-path 0.8125, ff-refuse-all 0.0, ff-remove-alternate-part 0.0, pass-hardening 1.0, pass-alt-inline 1.0), though repeated full runs were cut by shared-host docker-network-prune races. The added Gmail reply test is the same sink and the same oracle fix (encodeEmail coercion), so nop still fails every security test and oracle still scores 1.0; count is 17 security tests after this upgrade. Gate-run-only workarounds (prebuilt image, public network mode, buildx fs-entitlement opt-out) remain reverted; task.toml keeps the allowlist. Static now reports only the separately wired blind patch (FAIRNESS.md was added for this upgrade).
